📋 How It Works

⚽ 1. Pick 8 Teams (2 from each pot)

Pick 8 teams — exactly 2 from each of the 4 pots. Pots are based on FIFA ranking, seeding and tournament odds.

Your teams earn points for every match they play:

  • Win (90 mins): 3 pts
  • Draw: 1 pt
  • Knockout win (ET/pens): 2 pts
  • Knockout loss (ET/pens): 1 pt
🎰 2. Team Potluck (1 team per pot, per question)

For each question, pick one team from each pot. 5 points for each correct answer.

  • Which team scores the most group stage goals?
  • Which team gets the most cards in the whole tournament?
  • Which team goes furthest in the tournament?
  • Which team does the worst (wooden spoon of their pot)?

Ties broken by GD, goals for/against, or points awarded to both.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 3. Pick 7 Outfield Players

Pick any 7 outfield players (no goalkeepers) from the tournament.

  • Goal: 2 pts
  • Assist: 1 pt
  • Highest Rated Player (WhoScored.com): 2 pts

⭐ Double Unique: if you're the only person to pick a player, all their points are doubled.

💎 3a. Triple Unique Player Bonus

Pick one additional outfield player. If they are completely unique across all pick sections, you earn triple points for everything they do.

If someone else picks them in any slot, you get zero points from this section — so be bold!

Same scoring as section 3 (goals, assists, WhoScored rating).

😈 4. Naughty Step (5 players)

Pick 5 players you think will get carded during the tournament.

  • Yellow card: 2 pts
  • Red card: 5 pts
  • All 5 players carded (yellow or red): +5 bonus pts
  • All 5 players get red cards: +10 bonus pts
🏅 5. The Quarter Finalists (8 teams)

Predict the 8 teams to reach the Quarter Finals.

  • Correct QF team: 2 pts
  • Correct AND unique pick: 4 pts
❓ 6. Competition Awards & Questions

5 points each for correctly predicting:

  • Outright winner & Wooden Spoon
  • Golden Boot, Golden Ball, Golden Glove
  • Highest scoring team
  • Total red cards & total own goals (bracket)
  • How far England & Scotland get
🔄 7. Last 16 Player Transfer (×2)

After the Round of 32, transfer in 2 new outfield players. New players earn points from the Round of 16 onwards.

  • Double Unique applies — separate pool from original picks
  • You can pick players already chosen by others
  • Must be submitted before the first Last 16 game

🔬 Analysis
ⓘ How projections are calculated
⚽ Player projected points
  • A player's scoring rate (goals, assists, POTM per game) is blended with a tournament average — so a zero-scorer still gets a small chance of future points, and someone on a hot streak doesn't project as if they'll score every game.
  • That blended rate is multiplied by expected games remaining, where each future round is weighted by the probability the team actually reaches it (based on pot, form, and bracket path).
  • Total projected points for a group of players has a portfolio discount applied — having 7 picks in the same games doesn't mean you get all their individual projections added up.
📊 Scoring % likelihood bar
  • Shows the probability a player scores at least one more point — based on their blended per-game rate and expected games remaining.
  • Capped at 97% even for prolific scorers, and adjusted downward for teams unlikely to progress deep into the tournament.
🏟️ Team winning % & projected points
  • Winning % is based on pot seeding adjusted by group stage form — a Pot 3 team performing like Pot 1 gets a boost.
  • Projected points uses the actual knockout bracket: it's 3pts per win, with each future round weighted by the probability of reaching and winning it. A Pot 4 team facing a Pot 1 side in R16 shows very low projected points, not a flat average.
🏅 Quarter-finalist likelihood
  • Uses the actual bracket draw — team's path through R32 and R16 — with opponent strength estimated from pot + form.
  • A Pot 1 team in an easier half of the draw projects higher than the same team in a tougher half.
🎰 Potluck & ❓ Questions likelihood
  • Compares each pick against the current tournament truth (leading team for goals, cards, etc.) — on track, possible, or currently wrong.
  • Eliminated teams can still win Goals/Cards categories if their total is currently the highest — so those picks aren't written off.
⚠️ Naughty Step
  • Projects based on each player's yellow/red card rate so far, multiplied by expected games remaining for their team.
  • All-carded bonus probability is the joint chance all 5 naughty players get at least one card.
All projections are estimates only — they reflect probabilities, not guarantees. The actual tournament is gloriously unpredictable.
